body:
I took approximately about 200 mgs of this substance over the night, ingesting about 5-30mg a piece starting with 5 mg, and increasing the dosage as time went by.
Starting with about 10mg, i feel subtle, very subtle, though notice able effects starting to take place in the form of shapes of people in the dark, and some visionary disorders in the field of vision sort of holograms and such that are noticeable as hallucinations as soon as you look at them.
After about 1 hour i notice no notice able difference in the effects, so i decide to take more since i'm 99 % sure the high doesn't suddenly hit me out of nowhere.
Perhaps about 2 hours in to the experience i notice i find it hard to write coherently, i know what i want to write but my coordination doesn't work anymore - this is where the 'trip' starts to take place somewhat - during the evening i would consider of being really stoned, might be due to the long time between the doses even though i wouldn't say that i was sober in any meaning of the word, clearly, i was tripping but i consider myself quite experienced with high doses, having only tried a few though, so that even though i took a 'quite' large dose for my first methoxetamine experience my trips with dxm gave me the sort of insight into this substance so i knew what i was going through, sort of, even though this was still distinguishable from dxm, having some effects that are the like to it but others that are charasteritic to this only - or maybe to others too but don't know since i haven't tried that many yet.
I noticed the kind of m-hole kind of experience at a time, the feeling of sinking of sorts, in to the middle of our reality.
After this i experienced some sort of hallucinations taking place, though they we're all the sorts that you realized weren't real.
The major downsides in this substance is a weird feeling of violent thoughts - i was feeling quite absurd, like i could suddenly for no apparent reason jump out the window, hit somebody in the face or stab someone with a knife - without further thinking it.
And also this stuff makes, atleast me, not being able to sleep and still a drowsy feeling so that you are unable to sleep even though that you want to.
Also a paranoia due to the possibility of violence towards yourself or others without no apparent reason was very negative in my opinion - if you try this do not take as much as i did since you my end up killing somebody if you loose control of your actions - be careful this may happen - i didn't attack anybody but i felt a strong urge to do so even though i all the time realized that i never want to hurt anybody and that the consequences would be lethal.
In my opinion there are better drugs, like dxm which has not caused me to feel violent - i have had bad trips on it but never has caused me to hurt other people, even though how high i have  been on it.
Perhaps i'll continue experimenting on it - since this substance, as it seems has dangerous potential in some sort of neurological way - so be careful.
